test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The working conditions also include prevention of sexual harassment of working women and making arrangements in the organisation for it, this falls under ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 43.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 43:-

 
 
• It states that the State shall endeavour to secure living wages and decent standard of life for workers, while the question specifically mentions prevention of sexual harassment.
 
• The prevention of sexual harassment of working women is an important aspect of ensuring safe and equitable working conditions for all employees. 
 
 
 
• **Article 42:-**
 
 
• It states that the State shall make provisions for securing just and humane conditions of work and for maternity relief. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 44:-**

 
 
• It deals with Uniform Civil Code for citizens, while Article 45 deals with free and compulsory education for children.
